# v2026.11.3

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.3.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.3.md).

This release covers **11 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Open the new Home page to see the invoices that are ready and send them all with one Send. ([#478](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/478))
- Give one AI assistant a Flow key to run invoicing and read Seazona cases. ([#479](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/479))
- Let the assistant reconcile jobs, Flow invoices and Xero, with safe list reads from Seazona. ([#481](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/481))
- Let the assistant compare prices and price codes, and fix them. ([#482](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/482))
- Let the assistant read the review queue and work the Seazona history import. ([#483](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/483))
- Free jobs that are stuck on a void invoice, and release holds with a written reason. ([#485](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/485))
- Get the assistant skill from your Flow installation, and update it with `flow.sh update`. ([#484](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/484))

## Changes

- Add a Home page that lists the invoices that are ready and sends them with one Send. ([#478](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/478))
- Add an assistant key: one AI assistant uses a Flow key to run invoicing and read Seazona. ([#479](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/479))
- Let the assistant key reconcile jobs, Flow invoices and Xero, and read Seazona lists safely. ([#481](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/481))
- Let the assistant skill compare and fix prices and price codes. ([#482](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/482))
- Let the assistant key read the review queue and work the Seazona history import: batches, decisions, apply and backfill. ([#483](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/483))
- Serve the assistant skill from Flow, and add `flow.sh update` to update it. ([#484](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/484))

## Fixes

- Free jobs that are stuck on a void invoice, and release a hold with a reason that Flow records. ([#485](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/485))
